Big news for Tesla's robotaxi plans! 

Lars Moravy (Tesla VP of Vehicle Engineering) just replied with a clear "No" when asked if the NHTSA's 2,500 vehicle annual cap on FMVSS exemptions for steerless autonomous vehicles applies to the Cybercab.

This means Tesla designed the Cybercab to fully comply with federal safety standards — no exemption needed, no artificial production limit.

Huge for scaling unsupervised FSD robotaxis at high volume. No more "only 2,500 per year" FUD.

Tesla just proved it’s far more than an EV company — it’s building the future at warp speed.

Q1 2026 earnings delivered clean beats on revenue, EPS, gross margins, and free cash flow, plus record FSD subscriptions that keep rolling in.

But the real story is the multi-front acceleration most people are still sleeping on:
Cortex 2 already training  
Optimus factory construction kicking off at Giga Texas  
Cybercab production officially underway  
Tesla Semi and Megapack 3 lines starting soon  
Nevada LFP battery factory ramping hard  
New research chip fab breaking ground

Autonomy, humanoid robots, energy storage, and next-gen AI compute — all firing at once while the core business stays rock-solid.

This isn’t just a good quarter.  Tesla is entering its most exciting era yet.
Optimus Factory at Giga Texas being prepped

TESLA Earnings Q1:

Robotaxi & FSD momentum is ridiculous

Paid Robotaxi miles nearly doubled QoQ

Unsupervised rides now live in Dallas + Houston (expanded in Austin)

FSD (Supervised) moving to subscription-only → record 
net adds and growing adoption/penetration

v14.3 just launched with major RL + vision upgrades

Spring Update rolling out with “Hey Grok”, new Self-Driving App, etc.

TESLA Earnings Q1: 
AI compute & silicon ramp is insane

Cortex 2 cluster now online and running training workloads

AI5 inference chip fully taped out in April

Partnership with SpaceX for the largest chip fab ever (Tesla-owned Research Fab at Giga Texas already underway). Vertical integration on steroids.

TSLA Earnings Q1:
Tesla Optimus factory ramp officially begins

First large-scale Optimus line (designed for 1 million robots/year) prep starts Q2 in Fremont — will replace Model S/X lines

Giga Texas already prepping the second-gen line for long-term 10 million annual capacity. This is real.

Q1 Tesla Earnings:
Services & Other revenue exploding
+42% YoY to $3.745B — the fastest growing segment in the company right now. 

FSD subscriptions, Robotaxi miles, insurance, and ancillary services are all scaling hard while the hardware business stays rock-solid.

TESLA Supercharger network on absolute steroids

+19% YoY growth → 8,463 stations and 79,918 connectors

Added over 2,200 net new stalls in Q1 alone

V4 Supercharging cabinets now in production at Giga NY (3x power density + 2x stalls per cabinet). Japan expansion coming hard this year too.

The 2026 product & infra ramp is real  

Tesla started ramping lithium, cathode, and LFP production  

Cortex 2 AI training cluster now online and running workloads  

Cybercab, Tesla Semi, and Megapack 3 all on track for volume production this year  

First large-scale Optimus factory lines prepping in Fremont + Texas (1M+ then 10M+ annual capacity long-term)  

AI5 inference chip taped out in April

The auto business is solid and growing, but the real story is the vertical integration of AI, energy, and robotics infrastructure that’s now visibly accelerating.  
Tesla isn’t just an EV company anymore — it’s building the foundation for Amazing Abundance.  The future is incredibly bright.

Tesla Unsupervised Robotaxi is HERE

Paid Robotaxi miles nearly doubled sequentially in Q1
Now live unsupervised in Dallas + Houston (expanded in Austin too)

Cybercab will eventually replace a huge chunk of the Model Y fleet and become the highest-volume vehicle Tesla makes

Safety-first approach paying off.

Tesla FSD (Supervised) is exploding
Active subscriptions hit 1.28 million → +51% YoY with record net adds in Q1

Shifted to subscription-only and customers are piling in
v14.3 just dropped with major RL, vision encoder, and compiler upgrades

FSD approval in Netherlands (path to more EU countries) + progress in China

Tesla Non-GAAP profitability on steroids
$1.45B non-GAAP net income

$0.41 non-GAAP diluted EPS

Free cash flow $1.44B

Cash & investments up another $0.7B to $44.7B

This is the financial flexibility needed to fund the massive 2026 ramps.

TESLA Gross margin explosion:
GAAP gross margin hit 21.1% — up 478 basis points YoY.

 Total gross profit $4.72B (+50% YoY). 

Operating income $941M (+136% YoY). Even with energy revenue down seasonally, the machine is getting more efficient while scaling AI and autonomy infrastructure.

BREAKING: Tesla just dropped the Q1 2026 Update and absolutely crushed Street estimates on the things that matter:  
Revenue: $22.387B (beat company consensus ~$21.4B and Wall Street ~$22.3B)  
Non-GAAP EPS: $0.41 (smoked the ~$0.33–$0.37 consensus)  
GAAP gross margin: 21.1% (+478 bp YoY — insane expansion)

Auto demand was soft, deliveries were light, but the profitability engine is firing on all cylinders while the AI/Robotaxi/energy future accelerates hard.
